title: Stripe
summary: Payment gateway. Registers card, PayPal, Bancontact, Google Pay and Apple Pay into the core payment-method shell.
configure: Admin, Plugins, Stripe, Configure. Switches choose which methods checkout may offer. Stripe keys stay in environment files.
preferences: Payment method toggles also appear under Admin, Préférences (sign-in and payments). The gateway plugin owns checkout availability.
cart: Checkout lists only methods this plugin enables. Disable the plugin to hide every Stripe method.
orders: Captured PaymentIntents stay on the order. This plugin does not refund automatically.
profile: Customer stored cards use the core payment-method shell; this plugin is the gateway behind it.
